records.text: On 2023-05-20, the player chose Quest #4, “The Radio Signal.” The player followed a mysterious radio signal to an abandoned industrial complex outside a nearby city, where other survivors had established a temporary home. The survivors’ leader offered supplies in exchange for help fortifying the complex against mutant hordes. The player spent several days helping build walls, set traps, and reinforce entrances. The player started Quest #7, “The Bandit Heist,” which involved combat. Settlers found the bandits’ explosives cache and detonated it, enabling a final assault that defeated the bandits. The settlement was safe for the time being, and the player received a rare, powerful firearm belonging to a bandit leader. On 2023-05-23, the user provided side-plank troubleshooting guidance: for shoulder pain, check that the elbow is directly beneath the shoulder and that the shoulder blade is drawn toward the spine and down toward the back pocket; if pain persists despite correct form, brace the shoulder with the upper hand or use regressions until shoulder strength improves, then retry in a few weeks. For lower-back pain, adjust toward a flatter or more rounded neutral spine; if pain continues, use a regression and retry after a few weeks. Pain on the lower side of the abdomen is likely muscular if it resolves quickly after stopping. Avoid starting in a straight shoulder-to-foot line and lifting straight up; start with hips back and bring them forward while rising. Keep the body perpendicular to the floor and ceiling and do not roll the top shoulder forward.

On 2023-05-23, the user provided two side-plank regressions. For a side plank on the knees: lie on the side with legs stacked and knees bent at 45 degrees, hips positioned behind feet and shoulders, brace the core in a neutral spine, place the elbow beneath the shoulder, set the lower shoulder blade back and down, then raise the hips forward into a straight line from kneecaps to shoulders. If possible, raise the upper arm with palm forward and set that shoulder blade back and down. Hold 5–10 seconds, aiming for 10; lower carefully while braced and repeat 2–5 times, aiming for 5. For a modified side plank: lie on the side with the head supported by the lower hand or a pillow, brace with the upper hand on the floor in front of the stomach, brace the core in a neutral spine, lift both thighs and legs toward the ceiling at the hips, hold 5–10 seconds, then lower carefully. Repeat 2–5 times per side, aiming for 5; practice for a few weeks before retrying the knee version.

The proposed normalized asset-management schema contains six tables. Asset has AssetID as primary key, plus AssetType VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, AssetName VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, AssetDescription VARCHAR(255), and PurchaseDate DATE NOT NULL. Financials has FinancialsID as primary key, AssetID INT NOT NULL as a foreign key to Asset(AssetID), PurchaseCost DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL, CurrentValue DECIMAL(10,2), DepreciationRate DECIMAL(4,2), and DispositionDate DATE. Location has LocationID as primary key, LocationName VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, Address VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, City VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, State VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, and ZipCode VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL. Maintenance has MaintenanceID as primary key, AssetID INT NOT NULL as a foreign key to Asset(AssetID), MaintenanceDate DATE NOT NULL, MaintenanceType VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, MaintenanceDescription VARCHAR(255), and MaintenanceCost DECIMAL(10,2). Risk has RiskID as primary key, AssetID INT NOT NULL as a foreign key to Asset(AssetID), RiskDescription VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, RiskProbability DECIMAL(4,2) NOT NULL, and RiskImpact DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL. Compliance has ComplianceID as primary key, AssetID INT NOT NULL as a foreign key to Asset(AssetID), ComplianceDescription VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, ComplianceDate DATE NOT NULL, and ComplianceStatus VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL.
